lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical high-contrast white lines observed on the foreground torso; spacing is approximately uniform across the mid-section with narrowing intervals observed at the posterior convergence.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A singular Y-shaped bifurcation is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 5th line from the anterior shoulder, merging into a single vertical trunk.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Vertical lines 2, 8, and 10 terminate prematurely in the mid-lateral region, failing to intersect with the ventral boundary of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Cluster of 5 circular white spots observed on the lateral posterior haunch; density is highest in the mid-thigh region.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two posterior spots on the upper hind limb align horizontally to form a semi-connected geometric line segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Two high-contrast white spots visible on the zygomatic/cheek region; prominent white transverse bands (stockings) present on the upper distal segments of both the fore and hind limbs.
